description.en: Cybion's built-in operating guide (shipped with the source, shared by every user, read-only): how to work with features like the Ultimate Machine. Read this first when you need operating guidance.
description.zh: Cybion 自带的操作指南（随源码发布、所有用户共享、只读）：如何用终极机器等功能干活。需要操作指导时先读这里。

description.en: The Ultimate Machine: runs one bash check on a Worker on schedule and asks its bound Thread to repair failures; quiet otherwise.
description.zh: 终极机器：在 Worker 上按期执行一条 bash 检查命令，失败时请绑定的 Thread 修复；平时保持沉默。

description.en: Linkit's role in Cybion: identity, notifications and reach; why there are no linkit_* tools on the model side.
description.zh: Linkit 在 Cybion 中的角色：身份、通知与触达；为什么模型侧没有 linkit_* 工具。
